facts.claim: The Bombay tramways have a length of track of 17J miles, mostly double, and carried about 25 million passengers in 1904.
facts.quote: The Bombay tramways, owned by the municipality and worked by a com- pany, have a length of track of 17J miles, mostly double, and carried about 25 million passengers in 1904.

facts.claim: The Nasik tramway runs between Nasik Road Station on the Great Indian Peninsula Railway and Nasik town, conveying on an average 150,000 passengers a year over a length of 5 miles.
facts.quote: The Nasik tramway, also owned and worked by a private company, with a capital of one lakh, runs between Nasik Road Station on the Great Indian Peninsula Railway and Nasik town. It conveys on an average 1 50,000 passengers a year over a length of 5 miles.

facts.claim: A ferry service exists in Bombay harbour.
facts.quote: A ferry service exists in Bombay harbour.
